name: @repo/test-kit
description: Deterministic dataset generators and benchmark utilities for SLIC technical validation.

scripts.build: node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(({ rm }) => rm('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }))" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.clean: node -e "import('node:fs/promises').then(async ({ rm }) => { await Promise.all(['dist', 'coverage'].map((path) => rm(path, { recursive: true, force: true }))); })"
